description: Resource audit for factor workflow diagnostic stages

stages.known_resource_risk: Moderate — loads factor parquets + labels per factor
stages.resource_notes_zh: 已有因子子集支持，可指定因子列表计算
stages.resource_notes_en: Already supports factor subset via --factor-ids; moderate I/O per factor
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Can target specific new factors immediately

stages.known_resource_risk: Moderate — pairwise correlation matrix over full factor set
stages.resource_notes_zh: 需全部因子计算相关矩阵，无法子集
stages.resource_notes_en: Requires all factors for pairwise correlation matrix; no subset support
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run once after all new factors are evaluated

stages.known_resource_risk: Expensive — runs paper portfolio backtest per factor over full sample
stages.resource_notes_zh: 默认重算全部因子回测，开销大
stages.resource_notes_en: Runs paper portfolio backtest for all factors; expensive and no subset mode
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run in batch; consider splitting manually if needed

stages.known_resource_risk: Moderate — quantile shape + stability per factor over monthly windows
stages.resource_notes_zh: 默认重算全部因子，开销中等
stages.resource_notes_en: Computes quantile shape and stability for all factors; moderate cost; no subset
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run once after all new factors evaluated

stages.resource_notes_zh: PM-36后支持因子子集和增量合并模式
stages.resource_notes_en: PM-36: now supports --factor-ids and --only-missing with append/replace merge
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Use --only-missing after intake to compute only missing factors

stages.known_resource_risk: Expensive — selected-basket volume proxy per factor over sampled timestamps
stages.resource_notes_zh: PM-36后支持因子子集和增量合并模式
stages.resource_notes_en: PM-36: now supports --factor-ids and --only-missing with append/replace merge
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Use --only-missing after intake to compute only missing factors

stages.known_resource_risk: Light — reads existing diagnostics and builds unified profile
stages.resource_notes_zh: 轻量聚合脚本，无需子集支持
stages.resource_notes_en: Lightweight aggregation of existing diagnostics; no subset needed
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run after all diagnostics are current

stages.known_resource_risk: Light — checks file timestamps and state freshness
stages.resource_notes_zh: 轻量检查脚本，无需子集支持
stages.resource_notes_en: Lightweight staleness check on factor library state and outputs
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run at any time to verify freshness

stages.known_resource_risk: Moderate — reads all diagnostics and builds HTML page
stages.resource_notes_zh: 聚合所有诊断数据生成HTML页面，需全部数据完整
stages.resource_notes_en: Reads all diagnostics to build HTML; needs complete data
stages.recommended_use_after_intake: Run after all diagnostics are up to date
